description: Not affiliated with the U.S. government, GSA, or SAM.gov. Not a U.S. government service. Compares recorded notice facts with the baseline identified by a receipt previously returned by get_notice_record. The receipt must belong to the same caller and must not be expired. Reports source-supported fact changes and whether the supplied comparison filters changed; it does not compare or generate model estimates. Creates a new private comparison receipt, with the exact UTC expiry shown in expires_at. An empty changed_facts array means that no recorded fact changes were found against that baseline. Does not recommend bids, determine eligibility, or suggest partners. Follow-ups within 30 minutes after a search ride free (up to 30 per search); otherwise one accepted call counts as one use. Without a connected GovInbox account, both limits apply: 3 searches per UTC calendar day and 10 per UTC calendar month. With a connected GovInbox account, the limit is 20 searches per UTC calendar month, with no separate daily limit. One accepted search counts as one use, regardless of the number of records returned. Follow-up calls (opening records, comparing versions, listing awards or subawards) within 30 minutes after a search do not count extra, up to 30 follow-ups per search. A follow-up invoked with no active search window counts as one use and opens a new 30-minute window. Empty results consume the search. A lookup for a record that does not exist is not charged. Each retry of a search counts as a new search, as does each call for another page of search results. Daily limits reset at 00:00 UTC each day; monthly limits reset at 00:00 UTC on the first day of each month. Requests rejected for invalid authentication or an exhausted quota do not consume a use.

SearchFilters.description:
Caller-supplied comparison filters. Contains only six-digit NAICS codes
and listed US state or territory codes. Extra keys are rejected. These
filters are used for receipt input-change detection and do not change the
brief's content.

remaining uses, and reset time. kind is 'pseudonymous' (subject hash or
shared IP bucket, never called 'anonymous') or 'signed-in' (free GovInbox sign-in).
